verdict.rationale: Vestd documents some built-in background automation. Companies House is updated automatically after shares are distributed ('You don't need to do a thing'), filing is pitched as automated, and an HRIS integration replaces manual data transfer. These are fixed, vendor-defined automations, not ones the user designs. Missing for 10: user-configurable automation or workflow builder, triggers and schedules the user can set, agentic or AI-driven background tasks, API or webhooks for custom automations (OpenAPI probes returned 404), and independent corroboration.
